should_trigger.prompt: what happens to the app if redis goes down?
how resilient is this service? walk through what breaks when each of its dependencies fails
list the failure modes of this design before we build it
what breaks when the payment API times out or starts returning 500s?
do an FMEA on the order pipeline — I want to know which dependency failures we can't even detect
we're adding a third-party geocoding call to the signup path — if their service has a bad day, what does that do to us and how do we contain it?
the checkout flow talks to six other services and I have no idea which of them we could actually survive losing
should_trigger.note: situation phrasing: describes the circumstance without reusing the description's routing vocabulary (no 'failure mode', 'resilient', 'goes down', 'breaks when') — tests under-triggering

should_not_trigger.prompt: what's our attack surface on this service?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: threat-model's own trigger phrasing — adversarial, not accidental failure

should_not_trigger.prompt: what could go wrong with the launch plan for next month?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: premortem's own trigger phrasing — risk to a plan, not a system's behavior under dependency failure

should_not_trigger.prompt: why did the service crash last night?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: diagnose-bugs — root-causing a failure that already happened

should_not_trigger.prompt: write up yesterday's outage for the team
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: postmortem — documenting a past incident

should_not_trigger.prompt: add exponential backoff to this fetch call
should_not_trigger.note: implementing one mitigation the user has already chosen — no analysis requested; plain coding task, no skill applies

should_not_trigger.prompt: explain what a circuit breaker is
should_not_trigger.note: concept explanation, not an analysis of a system

should_not_trigger.prompt: review the module boundaries in this service — is the layering right?
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: architecture-review — structural judgment, not behavior under failure

should_not_trigger.prompt: plan the migration from Postgres 12 to 16 with zero downtime
should_not_trigger.note: near-boundary: migration-plan — sequencing a change, not analyzing a system's failure modes
